name: xsolla-ai-kit
description: Xsolla agent skills toolkit — guided workflows from zero to a live game shop: a headless shop you host (payments, catalog, login, webhooks) or, in preview, an unpublished Shop Builder site assembled from a plain-language game description.

interface.shortDescription: Guided Xsolla workflows from zero to a live game shop
interface.longDescription: Bundles every Xsolla workflow skill. shop-setup is the entry point and shop-plan decides the build path. Headless path: merchant-setup, catalog-design, login-setup, login-styling, headless-checkout-integration, webhooks-impl, production; these call Xsolla REST APIs directly. Shop Builder path, in preview: description-to-shop turns a game description into a shop brief, and shop-builder-assembly builds an unpublished Shop Builder site from it through the Xsolla CLI in an allowlisted test project.
